C: C2 [ C ] an object that is beautiful rather than useful
U: › [ U ] formal decoration that is added to increase the beauty of something

example: a glass ornament
玻璃飾物
garden ornaments such as statues and fountains
如雕像、噴泉等花園裝飾物
The building relies on clever design rather than on ornament for its impressive effect.
這幢大樓依靠其巧妙設計而非裝飾給人留下了深刻的印象。
She ornamented her letters with little drawings in the margin.
她在信的頁邊空白處畫上小圖案來作裝飾。

NONE: 裝飾性的，裝飾用的；裝飾的

example: a bowl of ornamental china fruit
一盤裝飾性瓷製果
The handles on each side of the box are purely ornamental (= they are for decoration only).
盒子兩邊的把手純粹是裝飾性的。
a plain gold ring with no ornamentation
沒有任何裝飾的普通金戒指

NONE: › having a lot of complicated decoration
裝飾華麗的，裝飾繁複的
› mainly disapproving Language that is ornate contains too many complicated words or phrases

example: a room with an ornate ceiling and gold mirrors
有華麗天花板和金框鏡子裝飾的房間
Some students are put off studying his work because of the ornate language of the poetry.
一些學生對學習他的作品沒有多大興趣，因為他的詩句結構複雜，辭藻華麗。

NONE: › likely to get angry and argue with people

example: He had been in an ornery mood all day, arguing with everyone who got in his way.
他一整天脾氣都很壞，跟每個妨礙了他的人都發生了爭吵。
